_comment: T-550, the Cosmetics submenu's text (HUD and menus, Content, 'Cosmetics menu texts'; Garage design, Decisions, 'Cosmetics'); T-553 reads it, no text in code. Keys: menu_button (the main menu's button that opens the submenu, next to Start, Garage, Past streams and Exit); title; locked (a locked item's label, slot {price} in coins); buy (the button that unlocks it); pick (the button that picks an unlocked item); equipped (the label on the picked item); not_enough_coins (the message when the player cannot pay); effects.<id>.name and .description for the 5 jump effects (dash_cloud the default and free, spring, jet_thrust, stunt_sparks, shockwave_ring). Every line scored 8 or more in the style loop, except effects.shockwave_ring.name (7, noted for the playtest).
title: Cosmetics
